title: Tensor support for canonical varying-ring extension
statement: Let R_n be arbitrary commutative rings and phi_n:R_(n+1)→R_n arbitrary ring maps. Use the canonical module systems and their derived categories on the vertical pro-etale sequence site [def-sp-varying-ring-operations]. Let j:U→X be an open immersion. Let A be any closed tensor structure for the actual derived internal Hom, with its flat-term K-flat representative model T [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. For arbitrary unbounded derived systems M on U and N on X, A.tensor(J_j M,N) belongs to the essential image of canonical extension J_j. This asserts only support, and does not choose any projection map.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; sites-modules.tex Tag 0E8I; Tags 06YS and 06YU. Labels lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor.

proof.text: Identify the actual constant coefficient tower on U with restriction of the tower on X along open composition. The inverse-image constant-section universal property identifies the ring maps and their horizontal transitions. This yields an equivalence from the actual U-system category to the restricted-ring module category. Uniqueness of adjoints identifies canonical extension on the actual tower with extension on that restricted-ring category. Derive these exact equivalences and adjoint identifications termwise.

Present the closed tensor A on flat-term K-flat representatives. The same total tensor models identify it with the normalized tensor on the restricted-ring geometric presentation: use its representative comparisons and localization uniqueness in two variables. Apply derivedTensor_openSupported there, and transport the essential-image witness through the derived equivalences and the tensor comparison. This transports support only; no normalization of a tensor projection arrow is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem tensor_openSupported
    (R : ℕ → CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, R (n + 1) ⟶ R n)
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (A : SemilinearSections.Closed.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X)))
    (T : SemilinearSections.Models.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X))
      (systemRing (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (coefficients R X) (coefficientTransition R φ X)) A)
    (M : Derived R φ U) (N : Derived R φ X) :
    (J R φ j).essImage (A.tensor.obj ((J R φ j).obj M, N))
